subject: Quick check on the recent purchase
text: I wanted to follow up about the purchase you approved last week. It looks great, but an unanticipated expense came up from the delivery surcharge. Nothing is urgent, and I can walk through the invoice if you would like. For now, I am making sure the next payment request includes a clear line item so the total is easier to track. Please let me know if you would prefer a short call or an email note. I appreciate your help. Thanks.
